macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks surge after Democrats win both congressional chambers
items.summary: The Dow rose about 3%, the S&P 500 gained roughly 1.6%, and the Nasdaq advanced about 1.4% as investors bet that divided government would limit fiscal expansion and reduce policy uncertainty. Small-cap, consumer-discretionary, healthcare, and renewable-energy shares outperformed, while defense and AI-infrastructure stocks weakened.

items.title: Oil prices plunge nearly 8%
items.summary: Brent and WTI crude fell about 8% as markets reassessed geopolitical and supply risks after the U.S. midterm election result. Energy shares lagged sharply while lower fuel costs supported broader risk appetite.

items.title: Treasury yields fall and gold tops $4,000
items.summary: U.S. Treasury yields declined by roughly 3–7 basis points across the curve, while gold climbed about 3.5% back above $4,000 an ounce. The dollar weakened to its lowest level since late September, and bitcoin moved above $80,000.

items.title: ECB rate-hike expectations strengthen after higher inflation
items.summary: Eurozone markets awaited inflation data after reports indicated consumer-price growth had risen to a three-year high. Investors increasingly priced a potential ECB rate increase, while the central bank’s deposit rate was previously reported at 2.50%.

items.title: Novo Nordisk raises outlook after strong earnings
items.summary: Novo Nordisk shares rose nearly 6% after the company reported third-quarter adjusted operating profit above expectations and raised its full-year sales and profit forecasts, lifting European equities.

items.title: AMD beats estimates as data-center demand remains strong
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices reported quarterly revenue and earnings comfortably ahead of expectations, with strong data-center growth and guidance that helped ease concerns about artificial-intelligence infrastructure demand.

items.title: Amgen reports higher revenue and earnings
items.summary: Amgen’s third-quarter revenue rose 8% year over year to $10.4 billion, while GAAP earnings per share increased 19% to $7.08. Operating margin also expanded substantially, according to the company’s reported results.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $79,000 as U.S. midterm results drive volatility
items.summary: Bitcoin rose more than 2% over 24 hours and traded above $79,000, while crypto stocks were mixed after a reported Democratic sweep of Congress increased expectations for regulatory scrutiny.[1]

items.title: Crypto market slips as Bitcoin and Ethereum remain below weekly highs
items.summary: The global crypto market capitalization fell 0.6% to about $2.655 trillion. Bitcoin was around $76,586, down 0.3% in 24 hours, while Ethereum was near $2,256, down 0.1%; XRP gained about 0.9%.[3]

items.title: SEC issues no-action letter classifying Canton Coin as a digital commodity
items.summary: The SEC’s Division of Corporation Finance issued a no-action letter stating that Canton Coin can be treated as a digital commodity, marking a notable U.S. regulatory development.[3]

items.title: South Korea proposes another delay to crypto-income tax
items.summary: South Korea’s ruling party proposed postponing the planned 22% crypto income tax, which was scheduled to begin on January 1, 2027.[3][6]

items.title: Shopify and Coinbase develop USDC payments protocol on Base
items.summary: Shopify and Coinbase are working on a Commerce Payments Protocol on Coinbase’s Base network to help merchants accept USDC payments.[3]

items.title: Riot Platforms signs $28 billion AI data-center lease
items.summary: Riot Platforms reported a surprise quarterly profit and announced a 15-year agreement covering its Texas data-center capacity with a leading AI laboratory, with approximately $28 billion in contracted revenue.[1]

items.title: Morgan Stanley joins institutional blockchain tokenization push
items.summary: Morgan Stanley said it is among the first banks to tokenize U.S. equities and Treasuries through the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation’s Tokenization Service.[3]

items.title: Ethereum targets post-quantum transition by 2028
items.summary: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake said the network could complete its post-quantum and post-AI transition by December 2028, ahead of the Ethereum Foundation’s stated target.[6]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Nintendo to release The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on Switch 2
items.summary: Nintendo is set to release a full remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on November 5 for Nintendo Switch 2 as part of the series’ 40th-anniversary celebrations. Reported upgrades include new visuals, voiced cutscenes, orchestral music, revised controls, and an expanded day/night cycle.

items.title: Valve reportedly tightens Steam review process amid platform growth
items.summary: Valve is reportedly adding stricter developer checks, with Steam’s review process said to have lengthened to as much as 12 days. The changes come amid concerns about the platform’s rapidly expanding game catalog and the role of AI-generated content.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 preloads reportedly begin November 10
items.summary: Rockstar Games has reportedly announced that Grand Theft Auto 6 preloads will begin at midnight on November 10 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series consoles. The game is scheduled for release on November 19, with the reported console installation size reaching 212 GB.

items.title: Anthropic restricts Claude Code from cloning existing video games
items.summary: Anthropic has introduced restrictions preventing Claude Code users from recreating specific existing games, even under different names. The tool remains available for creating original games and genre-based projects using original designs and assets.

items.title: Xbox reportedly targeting The Elder Scrolls VI more than two years away
items.summary: A report attributed to Bloomberg journalist Jason Schreier says Xbox’s target release window for The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel is more than two years away. Bethesda has so far revealed the game’s title and a brief teaser, but few additional details.

items.title: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 details emerge
items.summary: Reports highlight the launch timing, maps, and Warzone changes associated with Modern Warfare 4 Season 1. The developments represent one of the day’s notable live-service and multiplayer updates.
